_comment: SCA3 deliberately has NO Compound-treats-Disease edge: no disease-modifying therapy exists, only symptomatic management (e.g. physiotherapy, antispasmodics for symptoms, not the disease itself). This is intentional, not a gap in data collection.

node.name: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 3 (Machado-Joseph disease)
node.notes: Autosomal dominant, CAG-repeat-expansion neurodegenerative ataxia; most common dominantly inherited spinocerebellar ataxia worldwide. Not present in Hetionet v1.0's 137-disease set.

supporting_nodes.name: ATXN3
supporting_nodes.notes: Ataxin-3, a ubiquitin hydrolase (deubiquitinase). CAG-repeat expansion in the coding region (>52 repeats in affected individuals, vs up to 44 in unaffected) causes an expanded polyglutamine tract. Located on chromosome 14q32.1.

edges.evidence: CAG-repeat expansion in ATXN3 is the established monogenic cause of SCA3/Machado-Joseph disease (OMIM #109150).

deliberately_omitted.compound_treats_disease: No disease-modifying or curative treatment exists for SCA3. Management is purely symptomatic (e.g. physical/occupational therapy for gait and coordination, botulinum toxin for spasticity/dystonia). No Compound-treats-Disease edge is added, since 'treats' in this schema denotes treatment of the disease itself, not symptom palliation.
